title: Jony Ive, ex-OpenAI product designer Joey Flynn, and others on Silicon Valley's obsession with "taste" as a moat against AI slop and whether AI can learn it (Jonah Weiner/New York Times)
summary: Jonah Weiner / New York Times: Jony Ive, ex-OpenAI product designer Joey Flynn, and others on Silicon Valley's obsession with “taste” as a moat against AI slop and whether AI can learn it — To move through A.I.-era San Francisco as a relatively normal person is to confront the sheer volume of bewildering concepts that tech has lately thrust upon us.
